candidate.text: Sometimes I reread what I wrote and realize the sentence I thought was the most honest one is actually the sentence where I’m trying hardest to make them feel bad. I don’t always delete it right away, either. I’ll just sit there looking at it, because maybe the feeling underneath it is real, but the sentence itself is doing something else, and I’m still trying to work out what.

transfer_evidence.text: So maybe the first step isn’t becoming that adult all by yourself. Maybe you have to borrow someone else’s adulthood for a while—not just have them care for you, but notice what they’re doing, let them help you do some of it, and then try one small part yourself. I mean, that may be how the adult gets inside you in the first place: not because you suddenly know how to parent yourself, but because you’ve been close enough to someone doing it that, little by little, you can begin to do what they did.
